LanguageData.PPTE2_OrganSaleAffectsGoodwillTip: When enabled, selling a prisoner's organ for tickets lowers their home faction's goodwill toward the colony under vanilla rules. Disable to waive that goodwill penalty. Applies only to this mod's organ-sale surgeries; mood effects and surgical risks remain unchanged.
LanguageData.PPTE2_WorkTypeWagesHint: Leave blank to use the default rate. Available work is controlled by built-in labor or other work-assignment mods. Piece wages pay for successful output: production per batch, mining per deposit, construction per building, growing/cutting per plant, hauling per haul, cleaning per filth, research per technology split by contribution; other work types pay per completed job. NewRatkinPlus power generation defaults to hourly pay. In piece mode, each fully completed wheel session earns one unit wage; interruptions and timeouts earn no session payment.
LanguageData.PPTE2_IgnoreRiot: Ignore ticket check during mental break / prison break
LanguageData.PPTE2_DebtOrganHint: Food and entertainment cannot lower a balance past the credit limit. Parents contribute positive funds only. Existing debt remains if the limit changes or credit is disabled. Below the organ-sale threshold, prisoners request approval for one operation; surgery can still fail. Hygiene requires positive funds.
LanguageData.PPTE2_OrganRequestText: {0} has {1} {5}, below the threshold of {2}, and asks to sell {3} for {4} {5}.\n\nApprove to add one surgical bill. The organ must still be safe to remove when surgery begins. Surgery can fail, injure or kill the patient. Declining postpones further requests for two days.
LanguageData.PPTE2_OrganRequestUnavailable: This request is no longer valid.
LanguageData.PPTE2_AllowPlayerLoans: Allow prisoners to borrow from the player (approve each request)
LanguageData.PPTE2_BadDebtPenalty: Bad debt hurts the lender's mood
LanguageData.PPTE2_LoanTriggerBalance: Loan trigger balance (below this they borrow/beg/rob): {0}
LanguageData.PPTE2_SocialHint: Prisoners start these behaviors on their own when they can't afford food. Robbery is a real melee fight — it can be lethal! Per-prisoner toggles are in the prisoner config window.
LanguageData.PPTE2_RansomHint: Once a prisoner has saved up enough tickets and served enough time, they may occasionally ask to buy their freedom. You must approve for them to be released automatically — their tickets are used as payment. Per-prisoner overrides are available in the prisoner config window.
LanguageData.PPTE2_EnableChildParentPay: Allow child prisoners to use their parents' tickets
LanguageData.PPTE2_ChildPayHint: Child prisoners' meals can be paid from their imprisoned parents' tickets (requires Biotech children). "Own first / Parents first" sets the deduction order; "Shared wallet" treats the family as one account and shows the combined balance. Per-prisoner allow/deny is in the prisoner config window.
LanguageData.PPTE2_GizmoMenuDesc: Manage this prisoner's tickets (give/take), individual settings and ransom.
LanguageData.PPTE2_InvalidNumber: Please enter a positive number (decimals supported).
LanguageData.PPTE2_AllowOrganHarvest: Allow selling organs for this prisoner
LanguageData.PPTE2_RansomDisabledGlobal: Ransom is disabled (enable it in MOD settings).
LanguageData.PPTE2_RansomRequestPending: {0} offers {1} {2}(s) to buy freedom — awaiting your approval!
LanguageData.PPTE2_RansomEligibleWait: Requirements met — waiting for the prisoner to ask…
LanguageData.PPTE2_HediffTip_Debt: Owes {0} {2} of {1}. Wages and other income repay the debt first.
LanguageData.PPTE2_MealOnCredit: {0} ate {1} on credit and now owes {2} {3}(s). Wages and other income will repay the debt first.
LanguageData.PPTE2_NoTicketsBlocked: {0} couldn't eat: needs {1} {2}(s), remaining funds and credit cover {3}.
LanguageData.PPTE2_LoanRepaidMsg: {0} repaid the loan of {2} {3}(s) borrowed from {1}.
LanguageData.PPTE2_RobberyFailedMsg: {0}'s robbery of {1} failed and {0} got beaten up.
LanguageData.PPTE2_RansomHasDebt: Cannot ransom with an outstanding loan.
LanguageData.PPTE2_RansomRequestMsg: {0} offers {1} {2}(s) to buy freedom and awaits your approval.
LanguageData.PPTE2_RansomNoLongerEligible: {0} no longer meets the ransom requirements; request voided.
LanguageData.PPTE2_EnableBuiltinLabor: Enable built-in prisoner labour (used when Prison Labor is not installed)
LanguageData.PPTE2_BuiltinLaborDisabledByPL: Prison Labor detected: the built-in labour system is disabled and prisoner work assignment is managed by Prison Labor. Ticket wages are unaffected.
LanguageData.PPTE2_PrisonerWorkDefaultOn: Force new prisoners to work by default
LanguageData.PPTE2_EnableMotivation: Enable motivation (unsupervised/hungry prisoners lose motivation and slack off)
LanguageData.PPTE2_MotivationThreshold: Laziness threshold (prisoners refuse work below this): {0}
LanguageData.PPTE2_PrisonWorkHint: Note: warden, doctor, handling, firefighting, hunting and other sensitive/violent work types are never available to prisoners. Work types added by other mods can be enabled here but won't appear as columns in the Prisoners tab (they default to normal priority). Changes apply to all current prisoners immediately.
LanguageData.PPTE2_PrisonTabDisabledPL: Prison Labor is installed; the built-in labour system is disabled.\nPrisoner work is managed by Prison Labor.
LanguageData.PPTE2_PrisonTabDisabledSetting: The built-in labour system is disabled in the mod settings.
LanguageData.PPTE2_ColWorkToggleTip: Force this prisoner to work for meal tickets (overrides the global default).
LanguageData.PPTE2_ColMotivationTip: Motivation: {0}. Below {1} this prisoner refuses to work.
LanguageData.PPTE2_ColBalanceTip: {0} balance. Click to open this prisoner's menu.
LanguageData.PPTE2_LaborAreaExpandDesc: Designate a prisoner labor area. Colonists will not work inside it, leaving the work to prisoners.
LanguageData.PPTE2_MotivationTip: Motivation falls when unsupervised or starving, and rises when supervised, well-fed or paid. Below {0} the prisoner refuses to work.
LanguageData.PPTE2_EnableCellAutoRequest: Broke prisoners request automatically when a comms console is in their cell
LanguageData.PPTE2_RequestSilverMinFactor: Request range lower bound (× prisoner value): {0}
LanguageData.PPTE2_RequestSilverMaxFactor: Request range upper bound (× prisoner value): {0}
LanguageData.PPTE2_RequestHint: Colonists or slaves can right-click a comms console to request upkeep for a prisoner from their faction. On success, silver is drop-podded near the console and the prisoner gains the same amount of {0} (at the silver exchange rate). The range and success chance scale with the prisoner's market value; the caller's Social skill raises the odds, and asking closer to the maximum lowers them. Each prisoner has a cooldown whether the request succeeds or not. Build a comms console inside a cell and broke prisoners will walk over and call their faction themselves.
LanguageData.PPTE2_RequestTicketsOption: Request meal tickets for a prisoner…
LanguageData.PPTE2_RequestDialogTitle: Request meal tickets for a prisoner
LanguageData.PPTE2_RequestSelectHint: Select a prisoner on the left
LanguageData.PPTE2_RequestFailed: {0}'s faction ({1}) refused the request for {2} silver.
LanguageData.PPTE2_RequestSucceededText: {0}'s faction ({1}) agreed to the request and drop-podded {2} silver; {0} also received {3} {4}.
LanguageData.PPTE2_EnableJoyFees: Charge prisoners for using joy buildings
LanguageData.PPTE2_CustomJoyFeesTitle: Per-building fees (silver per use, blank = default)
LanguageData.PPTE2_JoyHint: Prisoners pay when using recreation buildings: once per full in-game hour, prorated if interrupted; silver is converted to {0} at the exchange rate. Walking and meditation are free. Food and entertainment credit share the configured balance floor. A session requires enough funds or credit for one hour. The recreation need is for display and billing only and does not affect mood.
LanguageData.PPTE2_JoyBlocked: {0} cannot afford entertainment (needs {1} {2}, remaining funds and credit cover {3}).
LanguageData.PPTE2_EnableHygieneFees: Enable hygiene fees (toilets/showers billed by water & power use)
LanguageData.PPTE2_HygieneModMissing: Dubs Bad Hygiene not detected; the settings below have no effect.
LanguageData.PPTE2_HygieneHint: Only active with Dubs Bad Hygiene installed: prisoners pay {0} for the water and power consumed when using toilets or showers. Prisoners who cannot pay are banned from using them — they will hold it in until they have an accident, or stay dirty; if their cell can reach a river they can still wash there for free. Hygiene fees never go on credit.
LanguageData.PPTE2_HygieneBlocked: {0} cannot afford hygiene fees (needs {1} {2}, has {3}) and has to hold it in.
LanguageData.PPTE2_FreeJoyAll: Joy fees waived for all prisoners
LanguageData.PPTE2_FreeHygieneAll: Hygiene fees waived for all prisoners
LanguageData.PPTE2_FeeExemptHint: To make specific foods free, tick them in the Free column on the Food prices tab (corpses and nutrient paste included). Each prisoner can also be set free/charged per fee category in the Configure Prisoner window.
